title: Career Roadmap · F&B Steward
summary: An F&B (Food & Beverage) Steward provides guest service in restaurants, hotels, resorts, banquets, cruise ships and other food-service operations.

about.label: Common entry route
about.text: Class 10/12 → hospitality or food-service training → practical experience → steward role. A diploma in Hotel Management/Catering Technology is relevant, but is not always mandatory for entry-level steward jobs.

blocks.label: Stream
blocks.text: Any stream; confirm individual course eligibility.

blocks.label: Useful subjects
blocks.text: English, communication, basic mathematics and business studies.

blocks.label: Explore
blocks.text: Restaurant service, table setting, guest relations, food hygiene.

blocks.label: Early skills
blocks.text: Spoken English, teamwork, grooming, punctuality and customer service.

items.text: Diploma in Hotel Management / Catering Technology → Food-service operations and hospitality.
Diploma in Food & Beverage Service → Restaurant, banquet and beverage service.
B.Sc. Hospitality & Hotel Administration → Broader hospitality operations and future supervisory roles.
Short-term food-service / hospitality certificate → Entry-level service skills.

blocks.label: Typical route

items.text: Direct overseas hiring is possible but depends on employer requirements, experience and visa/work authorization. Sponsorship is not guaranteed.

blocks.text: Trainee Steward ↓ F&B Steward / Server ↓ Senior Steward / Station Specialist ↓ Captain / Team Leader ↓ Restaurant or Banquet Supervisor ↓ F&B Manager (with suitable experience and progression)

CLASS 10 / 12 ↓ F&B SERVICE DIPLOMA / HOTEL MANAGEMENT COURSE ↓ SERVICE SKILLS + HYGIENE + GUEST COMMUNICATION ↓ PRACTICAL TRAINING / INTERNSHIP ↓ F&B STEWARD / SERVER ↓ SENIOR STEWARD / CAPTAIN ↓ SUPERVISOR → F&B MANAGEMENT
